title: OAC v0.1 Action Profile
description: Published by a tool's author (in MCP: the tool's _meta). Says what the tool does, whether and how it can be undone, its lowest tier, and which arguments the Preview must show. Unsigned; the executor's policy may only raise its tier. Rule beyond the schema: a read declares undo none.

binds.description: Preview field -> argument name. Every field a Preview shows must be bound here.
